title: Tiny, cute sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow underneath -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#1a3a2a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- seaweed wrapper (nori) -->
  <rect x='20' y='38' width='60' height='40' rx='8' fill='#2d4a3e'/>
  <rect x='20' y='38' width='60' height='8' rx='8' fill='#3d6b5a'/>

  <!-- rice body -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='52' height='14' rx='7' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='52' height='5' rx='4' fill='#fffdf5'/>

  <!-- rice texture dots -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#e8e0cc'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#e8e0cc'/>

  <!-- salmon filling visible at top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='20' ry='7' fill='#ff8c6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#ffa98f'/>

  <!-- cucumber strip -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='31' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#a8e070'/>

  <!-- avocado piece -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6bbf3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='31' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#8ed860'/>

  <!-- cute face on the nori -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='56' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='56' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#ffd700'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='56' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2d4a3e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='56' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#2d4a3e'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='54' r='1.2' fill='#fff'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='63' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6b8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='63' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff6b8a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 65 Q50 71 56 65' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little arms/waves -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q12 48 14 44' stroke='#2d4a3e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 52 Q88 48 86 44' stroke='#2d4a3e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- chopsticks -->
  <line x1='70' y1='20' x2='85' y2='15' stroke='#c8860a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='25' x2='87' y2='20' stroke='#c8860a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
